method.name: for_peer
method.description: Authorizes the Game's current Steam-verified participant using its configured channels. A guest resolves its authority. An authority resolves its admitted world-ready peers. The binding expires when the participant or current epoch retires.

method.name: authorize
method.description: Authorizes one distinct remote individual SteamID64 in a standalone scope. Supply one to 16 distinct names of up to 32 ASCII characters. Names begin with a letter or digit and may also contain period, hyphen, or underscore. This grants local routing permission only. Game scopes require [method for_peer].
